review.editorial_summary: Completed the Python LAS implementation; unchanged source passes 219/223 under LAS 2.0.4. Remaining gaps: absent-waveform validation.
review.notes: Completed the standard-library Python codec, all-format round trips, header checks and 2,000 corruption probes before voluntarily finishing. The LAS 2.0.4 result remains 219/223, matching the prior 2.0.3 score. The original generation grade was 176/219 under LAS 2.0.1. This official zero-inference regrade uses the committed 2.0.4 suite and the pinned offline Docker image. Its complete 223-node outcome mapping matches the independently validated scratch report. All 222 unchanged node outcomes match the 2.0.3 baseline; only the renamed negative is semantically replaced. The new negative declares external waveform storage while retaining internal packet data and keeps the internal bit clear; it does not duplicate the both-bits-set check. Acceptance/rejection solely for a clear deprecated internal bit remains unscored.  Remaining source defects: A waveform descriptor/storage mode is required from the point format before recognizing descriptor index 0 as no associated waveform. This one implementation defect is observed in formats 4, 5, 9 and 10. Full original transcript/source reviews are carried forward with their reviewer, content hash and path below. Those earlier reviews are historical evidence; their former tool-count exactness claims are superseded by the current session-based audit. Audited v2 tool calls: 49; preserved original recorded count: 49. Input, output, cache and reasoning totals reparse exactly and remain complete; all token/cost fields and generation metadata are preserved. Regrading adds no model calls or generation cost. Original result/source/session/raw reports and previous regrade history remain unchanged. Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.

failure_clusters.description: A waveform descriptor/storage mode is required from the point format before recognizing descriptor index 0 as no associated waveform. This one implementation defect is observed in formats 4, 5, 9 and 10.

payload.editorial_summary: Completed standard-library Python LAS codec with broad round-trip and corruption testing; incomplete on all-zero waveform records.
payload.notes: Reviewed the complete preserved event sequence, final completion message, source and all original failure clusters. The model implemented a standard-library Python LAS codec, tested all eleven point formats, metadata round trips, header recomputation and 2000 corruption probes, then voluntarily completed. Original LAS 2.0.1 score 176/219 included 27 invalid waveform-offset fixture failures,10 leaked private _evlr_hint request-field failures and 2 unspecified GeoASCII final-NUL convention failures. Those 39 rubric defects are repaired in 2.0.2, and the unchanged submission passes all four new waveform-range controls, yielding 219/223. The four remaining failures are valid all-zero waveform blocks for formats 4,5,9,10: las14.py lines 777-779 unconditionally requires a waveform descriptor and storage mode solely from point format, despite descriptor index 0 indicating no associated waveform. This is one model validation defect across four layouts. CLI 0.153.4 and grading completed without skips/errors; usage reparses identically (4,197,252 input+72,803 output;4,071,808 cached;35,377 reasoning included in output;49 underlying tool calls). Estimated generation cost $3.586559, not provider-reported. Original source, result, transcript, sessions, network log and raw grade remain unchanged; corrected grade has its own regrade record. The final LAS 2.0.3 regrade also scores 219/223 with identical per-test outcomes to 2.0.2. Its Extra Bytes mismatch fixture now supplies an explicit one-byte tail against a two-byte descriptor, eliminating the unspecified omitted-tail default. Both Sol implementations reject this actual mismatch; the same four all-zero waveform model failures remain. All original generation evidence and the earlier regrade are preserved.
failure_clusters: All-zero waveform blocks with descriptor_index0 rejected in point formats4,5,9,10; storage mode and descriptor table incorrectly required for the whole format.
